title: Home page has no <title>

evidence.observed: The document head contains no <title> element (0 title tags in the raw HTML).

expected: Every indexable page states its subject in a <title> of roughly 50-60 characters.
recommendation: Add a <title> to the home template that names the brand and what it sells.

expected_impact.rationale: Google uses the title element as the primary source of the result link text.

title: Article has no internal inbound links

evidence.observed: The crawl graph records 0 internal links pointing at /blog/a across 2 sampled pages.

expected: Every article is reachable from at least one in-body link on another page.
recommendation: Link the article from its section index and from a related post.

expected_impact.rationale: Internal links distribute crawl attention and describe the target with anchor text.

title: Could not decide whether the body is client-rendered

evidence.observed: No renderer was available in this environment, so the raw-vs-rendered delta was not measured.

expected: The primary content is present in the server response.
recommendation: Re-run with a renderer available to settle this.

expected_impact.rationale: Content only present after hydration is invisible to crawlers that do not execute JavaScript.
